about: Review by eye of MobileAgent-SFT-v4.7's new and changed rows before any round-9 candidate (2026-11-25), sheets from analysis/done_audit/v47_sheets.py (seed 47, 16 per kind)

relabelled_waits.notes: 14 clean; 2 inherit an AndroidControl quirk (the typed text is already visible before the input_text action), the same label the next row already had

nwait_rows.notes: search fields, lists, calendars, an ad with a Skip button; one AMEX label taps a corner icon (an original AMEX label)

nwaitload_rows.notes: loading: spinners, skeletons, splash screens, 'Requesting network', a chatbot typing, a countdown; defensible: a tap not yet answered, an interstitial ad, a live camera; looks loaded: a sign-in sheet, an inserted image, a Drive list, a ticket page (the next screen did change, so the app was still busy)
nwaitload_rows.decision: kept: 1,500 nwaitload vs 5,000 nwait rows (23% re-wait after a useless wait; humans in AndroidControl: 24 of 86, 28%)

second_review_32_more_per_kind.about: owner asked for 32 more by eye per kind; fresh rows (seed 48), the first 16 excluded; v47_sheets.py --more 32, with the episode's real next screen

relabelled_waits.notes: off target: XE 'click number one' at mid-screen, Houzz 'Save at bottom right' at mid-screen (the next row has the same label); wrong: Wanderlog wait on a blank page relabelled `complete` (that `complete` row was KEEP_NO_PROOF, stage 1: 'the screen is blank')

nwaitload_rows.notes: looks loaded: a 'Reminder updated' toast, a book page, a product list, a currency screen; dialogs: a contacts permission, a delivery-location sheet

second_review_32_more_per_kind.finding: 6 of the 10 doubtful nwaitload rows come from a wait right before `status` (vs 10 of the 38 good ones); the screen there is mostly the finished one
fixes_rebuilt: relabel a wait to `status` only if that status row was judged COMPLETE (1 row: the Wanderlog case)
nwaitload only from waits whose next real action is not `status` / `answer` (estimated doubtful share 21% -> 12%)

after_rebuild_nwaitload_16.notes: defensible: a progress bar after Save, a time picker animating, a video ad; doubtful: a 'apply last used filters?' sheet, a selected-dates calendar, a car page
